title: Asset sync
lead: Character images, sets, keyframes, videos and voices are sorted by episode, scene and shot and pushed to the ComfyUI canvas and the tools you already use, to view, arrange and keep working. New images and videos made in ComfyUI can be saved back into the same history.

targets.title: Where to sync

what.comfy: Each episode gets an asset board workflow in ComfyUI's workflow list (Drama / {{series}}). Assets are laid out in groups, ready to wire into your own generation workflows.
what.folder: Folders by episode, scene and shot, file names with the version; a .json next to each file records the prompt, model, cost and QA score.
what.eagle: Folders by series, episode and asset type, tagged automatically (character, set, status, model), with the prompt as the annotation. Good for filtering by tag.
what.resolve: The free edition gets a sorted folder and a timeline (FCPXML) instead: drag the folder into the media pool and make bins from folders. Studio can create bins, write metadata and markers automatically.

mapping.title: How the two sides relate
mapping.canvas: Moving, regrouping or deleting nodes in ComfyUI only changes the canvas, never the studio's data.
mapping.saveBack: Images, videos and audio from the Save to studio node arrive as new candidates for that shot or asset, get QA'd automatically and wait in the history for you to adopt.
mapping.later: Later: dragging a node into another group becomes a tag in the studio.
